limits: Binds recorded local validation to bytes; does not rerun any gate.
Allows a later documentation-only commit when recorded source bytes match.
Ancestry concerns the saved remote observations, not live remote state.
Poppler producer association uses the saved invocation and current artifacts; the producer receipt has no artifact hashes captured at generation.
Poppler executable metadata may identify a launcher wrapper, not its downstream native binary; no new executable-identity claim is made.

root_lock.tracking: ignored input, not a tracked Git lockfile

raster.comparison: Exact RGB pixels; no tolerance, rescaling, or alignment

text.normalization: Extracted text: remove trailing U+000A/U+000C only; authored text unchanged
text.identity_control: Raster only; deliberately not an extraction oracle
